title: Robust FP8 mode arbitration and progressive calibration for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Lena Park
description: Background: We want to enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) as a cost/throughput mode on Hopper GPUs but past attempts surfaced intermittent regressions for long-context and attention-heavy workloads. This ticket scopes a pragmatic and staged approach that: 1) introduces a deterministic arbitration layer that chooses E4M3 vs E5M2 per-model/per-batch based on calibrated heuristics, 2) adds a progressive calibration workflow (shadow -> partial traffic -> canary -> rollout) with tighter stability gates, and 3) expands telemetry to detect accuracy drift and latency anomalies quickly.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Arbitration service selects E4M3 or E5M2 deterministically and logs decision metadata for every request; 2) Calibration pipeline generates per-model profiles and a confidence score >= 0.92 on validation prompts before promotion; 3) Canary run handles at least 10M tokens across representative corpora without >0.5% degradation on regression metrics; 4) Automatic fallback to int8/float32 when safety thresholds are breached; 5) Documentation and a runbook exist for on-call to triage FP8 incidents.
proposed_solution: Introduce a lightweight arbitration microservice that consumes model metadata (layer shapes, activations histogram summary, typical sequence length) and outputs a mode tag (E4M3/E5M2/skip). Calibration will be reworked into a staged pipeline: shadow calibration (no traffic), sample-based validation against golden prompts, hysteresis-aware safety thresholds, and a traffic ramp with rollback triggers. Implement per-request telemetry (per-layer overflow counters, quantization scale drift, output embedding divergence) and gating logic that automatically demotes a model to a fallback profile when thresholds exceed limits.
implementation_tasks: - Add arbitration API and model metadata schema; - Extend calibration jobs to emit validation score and confidence; - Build canary harness that replays production traffic (sanitized); - Instrument runtime to emit new FP8 telemetry metrics; - Add rollout automation and rollback hooks to console; - Create smoke tests for long-context generation and attention stress tests; - Write runbook and update docs.
test_plan: Unit tests for arbitration logic and metadata parsing; integration tests that run calibration pipeline against 5 representative models (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder, long-context, chat); regression suite comparing outputs to float32 baseline using semantic similarity metrics (BERTScore/ROUGE/embedding cosine); latency and memory profiling under constant load; long-running canary (7 days) with daily validation snapshots.
telemetry: Emit: fp8.mode_decision, fp8.validation_score, fp8.per_layer_overflow_rate, fp8.kv_cache_hit, fp8.output_embedding_cosine_vs_float32, fp8.latency_p95. Dashboards: per-model FP8 health, fleet-level degradation alerts, canary dashboard for ongoing calibration runs.
rollback_plan: Immediate: automatic demotion to int8/float32 for models failing safety gates; Manual: operations runbook to pin to a previous quant profile and restart serving nodes; Postmortem: capture last 48h of telemetry, calibration inputs, and arbitration logs for RCA.
